Equal treatment act exists as recourse instrument (though its scope: health services and education — the DJ filed under it anyway).

- Facilities: sauna association guideline restricting women's saunas by primary sex characteristics (Jan 2025); operators set access privately; capital venues working out practice. - State climate: cabinet proposing safe-country designations for countries imprisoning LGBTI people; ending humanitarian admission for persecuted LGBTI; education minister banned gender-inclusive language; anti-discrimination office pushed back. These signal a hostile-leaning political climate (axis K), raising probability/severity modestly. Mostly refugee-facing, not visitor-facing.

- Hate-crime counselling infrastructure exists (northern campaign). Positive but limited.

- Marriage open to same-sex couples; resident-facing climate signals.

- Rule of law: complaints channels exist (equal treatment act, anti-discrimination office, press council etc.). Constitutional court struck down 1980 requirements. Institutions function; but the custody placement issue shows courts' review unestablished.

Assessment: No criminalisation of trans identity or expression. No documented street violence against trans visitors. No bathroom statute. Police: one documented airport harassment complaint; no pattern of police profiling documented. Here prison placement by binary/exceptional placement is documented but no documented assaults on trans inmates; "few safe spaces" reporting.

The 0.25-C anchor: prison housing by birth sex, assaults frequent, cross-dressing statute, etc. Our dossier: binary placement with exceptional exceptions, one documented transfer to men's prison, safety cited, few safe spaces. It's a conditional risk, not universal. Rule 15 covers universal-exposure measures "reaching every trans visitor every time" — custody placement doesn't reach everyone; only upon arrest. So it's a documented severe-but-conditional exposure.

Where does this land? The jurisdiction has strong formal equality machinery (self-ID law, equal treatment act, constitutional court), functioning institutions, hate-crime support, no criminalisation, no documented anti-trans violence. Exposures: airport screening harassment (documented once), custody placement (documented practice, conditional), private sauna gatekeeping, hostile political drift.

This dossier: one documented degrading screening by officers, prison placement hostile-ish, political climate backsliding (minister banning gender-inclusive language, ending LGBTI humanitarian programs). That's worse than 0.85. Compared to 0.75-C: Meridia border — training, tribunal, release; our airport case is worse documented (deliberate transphobic harassment alleged). Compared to 0.65-A: brief detention, apology+compensation, no discipline. Our dossier has no such documented remedy outcome.

I'd put it around 0.68–0.72. It's in Reduced Risk band. The custody exposure is the worst feature: tier 1 conditional (custody placement by birth-sex model with only exceptional identity placement, and a recent documented case of a legally-female person placed in men's prison). Rule 11 liability clause: institutions enforcing placement policy. But frequency for a visitor is low (requires arrest), and no documented assault. The political backsliding raises outing-consequence severity somewhat.

- vs 0.65-A: 0.65-A had actual documented detention of a visitor with intrusive questioning; ours has no documented visitor detention, but has custody placement exposure and screening harassment. Ours slightly better on street, worse on custody. Roughly comparable or slightly above.
- vs 0.75-C: similar border friction level; ours worse on custody and political climate; 0.75-C has documented compensation remedies. Ours slightly below.
- vs 0.55-E: ours clearly above (no transit ejection pattern, stronger legal machinery).
So 0.70 works. Adult with minor: nothing trans-specific documented for minors; conversion-therapy ban for minors since 2020 is resident-facing. No additional exposure documented; note not_documented.
